details:
This update for coredns fixes the following issues:

Changes in coredns:

- Update to 1.15.0:
  * Fixes VUL-0: CVE-2026-78669: excessive CPU consumption in HTTP/2 (boo#1285501)
    and CVE-2026-97032: HTTP/2 server crash due to HPACK encoder
    race (boo#1287577) by bumping vendored golang.org/x/net to
    v0.60.0.
  * Drops temporary google.golang.org/grpc pin for CVE-2026-84304 as upstream
    now vendors v1.84.0.
  * plugin/cache: cache SERVFAIL when resolver fails without response
  * plugin/forward: support DNS-over-QUIC upstreams
  * core: add opt-in JSON logging with structured DNS query fields
  * New features: SIIT support, expr-lang templates, PROXY protocol v2 metadata
  * Bumped minimum go build requirement to 1.26.0
  * Skip flaky timing/network-sensitive tests in %check (TestHealthMaxFails,
    TestReconnect, TestRace, TestSecondaryZoneNotify, TestPeriodicWeightUpdate)
